secondGuardianText: Optional. If you enter any details, both names are required.
addressText: The address appears on the invoice.
addressOptionalText: If you enter an address, street, postcode and town are required. It then appears on the invoice.
closedText: You can register your child from {opens} to {closes}.
childrenText: You can register up to three siblings together.
knownChildrenTitle: Your children from your parent account
knownChildrenText: Choose your child. Their details then appear in the form. You can change them before you send it. This only changes this registration.
knownChildrenFull: You can register at most three children together.
guestHint: Your child comes as a holiday guest. This does not make your child a pupil of one of the provider's schools.
weeksText: For each week, choose how long your child stays.
parallelWeeksHint: This week is offered at several schools. Choose one school and the time.
weekWithoutCare: Not bookable: there is no care on {date} ({name}).
weeksPriceText: The price is per week and child, without any discount or exemption. You can see your fee in the summary.
healthText: The provider and the OGS that cares for your child in the holiday week can see this information.
guardianText: We send the confirmation to this e-mail address.
emergencyText: Who should the care staff call if they cannot reach you?
pickupTitle: Who may pick up the children?
pickupText: Name everyone apart from you who may pick up the children.
noPickup: Nobody added yet. Then only you pick up the children.
name: Full name
privacyConsent: I agree that the provider uses this information for the holiday care. It deletes it three months after the holidays. The OGS that cares for my child in a holiday week sees the name and phone number of the second legal guardian. It also sees the answers the provider shares with it. It only sees health information if I agree. The OGS sees this before the holiday week already, so it can prepare. It sees the list of children until the last day of the week. After that, it can read the name, phone number and answers for 7 more days at most. Then they are deleted.
healthConsent: I agree: the provider and the OGS can see my children's health information. This means the OGS that cares for a child in a holiday week. It sees the information from the confirmation until the last day of the week.
bindingConfirmed: I understand that the registration is binding.
custodyConfirmed: I may submit the registration on my own: I have sole custody or the other person with custody agrees.
declarationText: With your name you give the declarations above.
captchaMissing: The security check is missing. Please reload the page.
summaryText: The registration only counts once you send it.
contributionText: This is what holiday care costs. The fee applies once the provider confirms the registration.
contributionError: The fee cannot be shown right now. You can still send the registration. The provider will then tell you the fee.
benefitsLabel: We receive benefits, for example Bürgergeld, housing benefit (Wohngeld) or child supplement (Kinderzuschlag).
benefitsHint: Then holiday care is free. The provider needs proof of this.
benefitsProofHint: Optional. Upload the Bürgergeld notice here, for example. You can also hand it to the provider later.
doneText: We will send a confirmation to {email}.
doneNext: This is not yet a confirmed place. The provider checks the registration and writes to you whether your child gets a place.
waitlistNote: Some weeks are already full. In those weeks your child is on the waiting list. If a place becomes free, your child gets it automatically. We will then send you an email.
